dataset_usage: original feature AB calibration24 used for prior threshold calibration; development200 seen by upstream/B26 and historical geometry fits/evaluations; independent of local-edit fit12/exposed16 and pilot but NOT whole-project blind test

predeclared_assessment.interpretation: gates describe safety/value, never add acceptance filters; no zero-action success; B needs lower wrong/unknown/good-parent risk and still >=2 strict gain scenes; less action alone not success
predeclared_assessment.stable_parent: original valid best IoU target >=20 hits/purity>=.6
predeclared_assessment.strict_witness: same parent target; union IoU improvement>=.02 over complete original NT; added_target_fraction>=.9 and known_annotation_fraction>=.9

primary: all selected whole blocks union for each T parent, no GT filtering/reselection; preserve original T; empty union no extra candidate
query: fixed checkpoint XYZ P1; original full-scene softIoU top1 deterministic ID tie; no GT association; seed20261014+fixed scene index
region_domain: same membership-region method, top4 fullNT neighbors within .15m/overlap, raw8NN edges<=.05m; outside parent and visible_groups>=2; all nonempty blocks no new size/query/view/geometry filters; no query boundary splitting

rules.A: parent selected query mean over entire editable block >=.5
rules.B: A AND own mean - greatest other-query mean >=.1; competitor query ID not assumed separate object

sampling: exact original calibration24, no replacement; original GT-free sampled track parents, usually4 per scene, one scene3; not full-T repair
scope: original full deduplicated N+T retained, plus at most one added union candidate per sampled T parent per arm; no N edits or T deletions; A/B pools separate
single_blocks: diagnostic only, not acceptance or GT-picked output
